answer: Social Matters >> Clothing & Lifestyle Question ID: 25049 Country: India Title: I have onle six or seven hair in beard.i want full beard that for can i use midicin for that. is it ligal in islam Question: assalamuylikum I have onle six or seven hair in beard.i want full beard that for can i use midicin for that. is it ligal in islam Answer ID: 25049 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1637/1283/B=1431) Yes, you can use medicine in order to grow your full beard. Islam does not prohibit it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
